notes: v0.3.21 - the first release since 0.3.18 that updates the app itself (0.3.19 and 0.3.20 only replaced the installer). The agent can open a browser you can see and read the page you are on. Setup asks its questions properly and remembers your answers. It runs as a real desktop app and picks ports that are free. Fixed: every Docker launch reported failure even when everything came up fine; LinkedIn was listed as connected while paused; Settings called the companion app up to date while the update button said to reinstall it.
